subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, as core TUI config templates, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses TUI rendering, public config, provider auth/usage data, and Plugin SDK boundaries; automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after ordering, truncation, caching, and auth behavior are approved.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class TUI footer template/config surface and accept the compatibility and migration burden for a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep status surfaces only
options.body: Leave /status, /usage, CLI status, and gateway usage APIs as the supported quota/cost surfaces and reject persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the linked PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering and provider-usage fields only after ordering, truncation, caching, and auth behavior are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to the current TUI footer, provider usage/status, and plugin boundary surfaces that shape the product/API tradeoff.
